operatorFacts: Livingston Post-Acute Care identifies itself as a skilled nursing facility.
The operator home page and About page publish phone 9737588200.
The operator Google widget says 489 reviews. This is not a second source family and does not replace the directly collected MyLivingChoice Google panel's 4.3/5 from 526 ratings.
Search discovery supplied 348 East Cedar Street, but the fetched home and About page text did not expose that address. Do not call the search snippet a full-page address witness.
decision: Current state detail and CMS identify the same nursing facility by exact name, street, ZIP, phone, licensed operator and 124 beds. The retained state roster reports 134 beds; preserve this source-period discrepancy rather than treating it as another facility. Operator name, nursing setting and phone corroborate the facility. Attribute at most once to the included state nursing record, without inheriting a consumer aggregate on the unresolved CMS record.
